Filters are applied server-side, so the total_count is the filtered total.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-app.fundz.net" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_lead_detail, search_funding_rounds, get_company_contacts · Private data: get_lead_detail, get_saved_filters, get_investor_profile, search_sec_filings, get_company_contacts, reveal_contacts, get_contact_reveal_quota · Public sink: toggle_email_notifications, get_company_contacts, reveal_contacts · Destructive: get_lead_detail, search_funding_rounds, get_saved_filters, remove_from_watchlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_lead_detail, search_funding_rounds, get_company_contacts · Private data: get_lead_detail, get_saved_filters, get_investor_profile, search_sec_filings, get_company_contacts, reveal_contacts, get_contact_reveal_quota · Public sink: toggle_email_notifications, get_company_contacts, reveal_contacts · Destructive: get_lead_detail, search_funding_rounds, get_saved_filters, remove_from_watchlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
